ns2:course.label: Res Studies in Animal Sciences
ns2:course.description: Directed and supervised study of selected research topics in Animal Sciences. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
